newsitem.title: USA: Rohr sees lower oper margin in first half.
newsitem.headline: Rohr sees lower oper margin in first half.

text.p: Rohr Inc said Monday it expected its operating margin in the first half of fiscal 1997 to fall short of its operating margin before unusual items the previous year.

The company said it was able to boost operating margins in fiscal 1996 despite a year-to-year sales decline. It said it thought margins for the entire fiscal 1997 would come close to those achieved in fiscal 1996.
Earlier, Rohr reported fiscal 1996 sales of $770.8 million compared with $805 million the previous year.
The company said fiscal 1997 sales should rise over 15 percent because of deliveries scheduled in the latter half of the year.
